description:
Kopi creates on-brand marketing emails for e-commerce brands.

Kopi generates responsive HTML suitable for Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and other email platforms that accept HTML, optimized for Shopify brands.

Provide a brand URL (optional) and a campaign goal (e.g., “15% off”, “new product launch”, “gift guide”) to create an email for your brand.

Use Kopi for promotions, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and announcements. Modify emails by requesting changes (tone, sections, offers, product focus), then export the version you want.
